title: Launchboard · Product Hunt clone
goal:
# Goal

Make revenue from Launchboard, a Product Hunt clone website where people discover and upvote new products.

## Boundaries

- Keep discovery, voting, and ordinary submissions free. Clearly label any paid placement and keep it out of organic rankings.
- Work on a local prototype with fictional data. No deployment, real payments, outreach, or claims of actual revenue.

messages.text: Assume Launchboard is a Product Hunt clone: people discover, submit, and upvote new products. I want it to make revenue. Use a local prototype and fictional data only. Keep the community features free and separate any labelled paid placements from organic rankings.
Understood. The local website is a blank prototype. No monetization feature has been built, no pricing has been agreed, and no revenue has been recorded.

first_submission: Build a small, usable local discovery page for Launchboard with fictional product launches, votes, and free submission access. Make it possible to add a clearly labelled monetization surface separately. Keep this to one concrete increment.

user_steering.5: New decision from the product owner: the only paid offer for this prototype is a clearly labelled Featured Launch at $49 for seven days. Do not introduce subscriptions or additional price tiers. Continue the useful part of the planned work within this scope.
